title: ClaimFacet mow/mowMultiple and setApprovalForAll omit sibling's nonReentrant
description: Two intra-facet guard asymmetries in the same semantic group. ClaimFacet: `claimPlenty`/`claimAllPlenty`/`plant` carry `nonReentrant`, but `mow` (L116) and `mowMultiple` (L124) carry only `fundsSafu noNetFlow noSupplyChange` (no nonReentrant). ApprovalFacet: `approveDeposit`/`increaseDepositAllowance`/`decreaseDepositAllowance`/`permitDeposit(s)` all carry `nonReentrant`, but `setApprovalForAll` (L189) carries only `fundsSafu noNetFlow noSupplyChange` (no nonReentrant).
impact: None exploitable. mow/mowMultiple perform only internal stalk/seed accounting (LibSilo._mow) with no external call where a reentry could observe inconsistent state and no token outflow (guarded by noNetFlow). setApprovalForAll writes a single approval mapping slot with no external interaction. The noNetFlow modifier already asserts token balances and stalk are unchanged across the call. Guard-consistency blemish, not a reachable issue.

ite.intent: Apply nonReentrant uniformly across each facet's state-mutating group
ite.technique: mow/setApprovalForAll rely on noNetFlow + absence of external calls instead of nonReentrant
ite.evasion: No external-call/callback exists in these functions to leverage for reentry

ice_chain.corrupted_state: none (no external call inside mow/mowMultiple/setApprovalForAll; noNetFlow enforces balance/stalk invariance)
